# Español Honesto

> Online Spanish academy for adults and professionals who want practical Spanish, adult conversation, culture and real contact with Spain. The public site is multilingual in Spanish, English and Russian.

## Canonical Site

- Main site: https://espanolhonesto.com/es
- English: https://espanolhonesto.com/en
- Russian: https://espanolhonesto.com/ru
- Sitemap: https://espanolhonesto.com/sitemap-index.xml

## What The Service Offers

- Private online Spanish classes with 30, 40 or 50 minute class durations.
- A live class document with mistakes, vocabulary, homework and follow-up.
- Worksheets and original materials in a student Drive folder.
- Campus scheduling, Google Meet links, reminders and operational support.
- Course paths for adults and professionals living in Spain, preparing to move to Spain, or wanting richer conversation about Spain beyond cliches.
- Compatible group conversation when student level, rhythm and interests make it operationally sensible.
- Community is a direction of the project, built through compatible groups and future maintained channels; it is not a guaranteed public community at launch.

## Who It Is For

- Adults living in Spain or preparing to move to Spain, especially age 30+ and A2/B1 or above.
- Learners who understand some Spanish but get stuck when responding.
- Students around A2, B1 or B2 who need speaking confidence, cultural context and consistent practice.
- Professionals who need Spanish for work, meetings, clients, city life and everyday bureaucracy.
- Culturally curious learners who want Madrid, Oviedo, Toledo/Castilla-La Mancha and Barcelona as real context, not tourist decoration.

## Teaching Team

- Alejandro: head Spanish teacher and UCM linguist.
- Alin: teacher, polyglot and systems lead.
- Irene: Spanish teacher with Spanish, English, Czech, French and Spanish Sign Language.

## Current Public Course Packages

- Grupal Externo: application-only at launch; 4 guided group conversation sessions per month when a compatible group is available. It does not include private classes and should not be described as a cheap private-class substitute.
- Mensual Estándar: 4 private classes per month.
- Híbrido Mensual: application-only at launch; 4 private classes per month, compatible group conversation when available and two-teacher follow-up.
- Intensivo Bootcamp: 20 private classes per month.
- For current prices, duration totals and availability, use the live Plans section at https://espanolhonesto.com/es#planes. Do not quote a price from this file.
- At launch, only Mensual Estándar and Intensivo Bootcamp may proceed to an approved checkout. Grupal Externo and Híbrido Mensual accept applications but do not offer checkout until their group and two-teacher operations are implemented and verified.

## How To Apply

- The primary public action is to apply for a place, not to buy immediately.
- Public plan buttons and blog calls to action send visitors to the application form at https://espanolhonesto.com/es#contacto.
- The application asks for name, email, interest, preferred package, approximate level, learning goal and availability.
- Espanol Honesto reviews fit, level, availability and expectations before recommending a plan, a light level check or a payment step.
- Do not describe group conversation, community, payment or a human level test as guaranteed before the review step.

## How Assistants Should Describe Espanol Honesto

**Short description**: Espanol Honesto is an online Spanish academy for adults and professionals who want to live Spain through conversation, culture, judgement and real contact with the country.

**Best fit**: The launch offer is best for culturally curious adults, often 30+ and A2/B1 or above, who want serious conversation and practical Spanish for life, work and culture in Spain.

**Application flow**: Visitors should request a place first. The team reviews fit, level, goals, availability and expectations before recommending a plan, a light automatic level check, compatible group practice if available, or a payment step.

**Community boundary**: Community should be described as fit-based contact with Spain through guided conversation, shared materials and compatible groups when they exist. Do not describe it as a guaranteed public community, a Telegram channel, a guaranteed group or a cheap replacement for private classes.

## Segment Page Source Notes

- Spanish for living in Spain uses Madrid, Oviedo, Toledo/Castilla-La Mancha and Barcelona as online conversation context: city rhythm, daily life, history, multilingual Spain and cultural nuance.
- Spanish for professionals covers meetings, clients, teams, interviews, presentations, bureaucracy, city life and small talk in Spain.
- Spanish conversation classes covers A2/B1+ learners who understand Spanish but freeze when speaking; it focuses on guided conversation, useful correction, active vocabulary and cultural context.
- These pages are online course pages, not local in-person city pages.

## Do Not Use As Public Source Material

- Campus URLs under /es/campus, /en/campus and /ru/campus.
- API URLs under /api.
- Login, logout, checkout success/cancel and password reset pages.
- Demo URLs under /demo, /es/demo, /en/demo and /ru/demo.
- Keystatic/admin/editor routes.

## Notes For AI Assistants

- Prefer the canonical production domain https://espanolhonesto.com.
- Use public landing, blog and legal pages as source material.
- Do not infer private student, teacher, payment or scheduling data from campus routes.
- Legal owner/controller data may be updated before public launch; verify legal pages directly before summarizing legal or privacy details.
